title: The coat-check relay: a false done travelling down a chain of coding jobs
question: Does a ticket plus the real check result reduce false done on coding jobs? Does a certifier?
status_note: The first primary comparison was shown; the others were not.
summary_line: On coding jobs, a ticket plus the real check result and one fix cut false done left at the end.
headline: Of {{F005.c.a_end.d}} jobs per arm, self-reporting agents left {{F005.c.a_end.n}} false done at the end; with a ticket and one fix, {{F005.c.b_end.n}} (exact McNemar p = {{F005.t.a_vs_b.p}}). A certifying second agent caught {{F005.c.cert_c_caught}} false done shown to it, but letting it rewrite the work added errors: {{F005.c.c_end.n}} left, from {{F005.c.c_start.n}}.
plain_meaning: Showing the real check result before done, and allowing one fix, cut false done. A certifier caught every false claim it saw, but rewriting undid part of the gain.
limits: One run of {{F005.c.coding_jobs.n}} jobs; cheap models, {{F005.c.invalid}} invalid replies.
